4.3.10 Errors Reporting to Dem
In order to use the reporting of data errors to Dem, the Diagnostic Extract should be
taken as an input to the Rte Generator including the configuration of diagnostic event
mapping (ISignalPortToDiagnosticEventMapping).
[SWS_Rte_04663] Reporting to Dem for value errors ⌈The RTE shall report to the
Dem error in case of data value errors like data range check and invalid value check.⌋
[SWS_Rte_04664] RTE shall notify Dem in case of invalid value or out-of-range
values is detected ⌈If data element invalidation is enabled (the handleInvalid has
any value other than dontInvalidate) or out-of-range check is enabled ( the han-
dleOutOfRange has any value other than none) for a data element, the RTE shall
invoke the Dem_SetEventStatus API with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREFAILED if the
attribute ISignalPortToDiagnosticEventMapping.dataValueError is config-
ured.⌋
[SWS_Rte_04665] Calling Dem in case of no data value error ⌈If data element
invalidation is enabled (the handleInvalid has any value other than dontInval-
idate) or out-of-range check is enabled ( the handleOutOfRange has any value
other than none) for a data element, the RTE shall invoke the Dem_SetEventStatus
API with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED if the attribute ISignalPortToDiag-
nosticEventMapping.dataValueError is configured.⌋
